# Terento

> Install and manage third-party maps on Garmin watches and Edge bike computers with map support using Terento, a free macOS app for Apple Silicon.

Canonical website: https://terento.app/

This supplemental index does not replace the website, robots.txt, or sitemap.

## Key facts

- Terento is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0-or-later) project that installs and manages third-party maps on Garmin smartwatches and newer Garmin Edge bike computers (such as Edge 540, 840, 1040 and 1050) with map support. Handheld GPS and automotive devices are outside its scope.
- Two ways to use it: the Terento app for Apple Silicon Macs with macOS 13 or later, or the web installer at https://terento.app/install/ in desktop Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Opera or Brave, with no app to install.
- The maps are free community maps based on OpenStreetMap data: Freizeitkarte, OpenTopoMap, MapRando, BBBike and OSMapaPL. The Mac app downloads each map directly from its provider and can also install your own compatible .img map file.
- Terento does not update Garmin firmware or official Garmin maps and does not replace Garmin Express.
- The Compatibility page lists exact Garmin watch and Edge models and variants with at least one successful installation. A model missing from it is not necessarily unsupported.

## Public pages

- [Terento — Third-Party Maps for Garmin on Mac](https://terento.app/): Install and manage third-party maps on Garmin watches and Edge bike computers with map support using Terento, a free macOS app for Apple Silicon.
- [About Terento — Free, Open-Source Garmin Maps for Mac](https://terento.app/about/): Learn why Terento exists: a free, open-source macOS app for installing and managing third-party maps on Garmin smartwatches and Edge bike computers.
- [Download Terento for Mac — Third-Party Maps for Garmin](https://terento.app/download/): Download the free, notarized Terento app for Apple Silicon Macs to install and manage third-party maps on Garmin watches and Edge bike computers with map support.
- [Garmin Watch & Edge Compatibility: Successful Installs — Terento](https://terento.app/compatibility/): Terento is designed for Garmin smartwatches and newer Edge bike computers with map support. See exact models and variants with successful map installs.
- [Install Third-Party Garmin Maps on Mac — Terento](https://terento.app/guides/install-garmin-maps-mac/): Install third-party maps on a Garmin watch with map support from an Apple Silicon Mac: connect it, choose a map or your own .img file, and install.
- [Garmin Watch Not Showing Up on Mac? Troubleshooting — Terento](https://terento.app/guides/troubleshooting/): Garmin watch or Edge not showing up on your Mac? Fix USB mode (MTP), Garmin Express using the device, low storage and failed map downloads.
- [Install Garmin Maps on Linux from Chrome — Terento](https://terento.app/guides/install-garmin-maps-linux/): Install free OpenStreetMap maps on a Garmin watch from Linux in Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Opera or Brave: add one udev rule, connect the watch, send the map.
- [Install Maps on Garmin Edge from a Mac — Terento](https://terento.app/guides/install-garmin-maps-edge-mac/): Garmin Edge 1050, 840 or 540 not showing up on your Mac? Install free OpenStreetMap maps or your own map file on newer Edge bike computers with Terento.
- [Compare Free Garmin Maps: OpenTopoMap vs Freizeitkarte — Terento](https://terento.app/map-styles/): See how OpenTopoMap, Freizeitkarte, MapRando, BBBike and OSMapaPL Garmin maps draw popular hikes, trails and cities before you install one.

## Web installer

- [Install Maps on a Garmin Watch or Edge from the Browser — Terento](https://terento.app/install/): Install free OpenStreetMap-based maps on your Garmin watch or Edge bike computer from Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Opera or Brave: connect by USB, choose, send.
